as october, the month of the holy rosary, draws to a close, we turn towards november, a month dedicated to remembering & praying for our faithful departed loved ones. the rosary can be a prayer of love & remembrance. for many of our loved ones, the rosary beads may have rested in their hands in their final hours, as family members gathered around them, praying the familiar decades. those familiar prayers offered comfort, reminding them that they were not alone, but surrounded by love & held in faith. annual novena for the deceased at masses from sunday 1st — monday 9th november the annual novena for the deceased here in our parish runs from: sunday 1st to monday 9th november . altar lists of the deceased are available at the back of each church. these can be returned to either church before or during the novena. during mass times there will be a box located in front of the altar. otherwise leave them in the silver box at the altar. ——————————— - while the church puts great emphasis on remembering our loved ones throughout the year, special emphasis is placed on them during the month of november, which begins with the great solemnity of all saints / all hallows november 1st the commemoration of all the faithful departed or all souls on november 2nd. norms for indulgences at the commemoration of all souls 1. from twelve o’clock noon on 1st november until midnight on 2nd november, all who have confessed, received holy communion & prayed for the pope’s intentions (one our father & hail mary, or any other prayer of one’s choice) can gain one plenary indulgence by visiting a church or oratory, & there reciting one our father & the apostle’s creed. this indulgence is applicable only to the souls of the departed. confession may be made at any time within the week preceding or the week following the 1st of november. holy communion may be received on any day from 1st to 8th november. 2. the faithful who visit a cemetery & pray for the dead may gain a plenary indulgence applicable only to the holy souls on the usual conditions once per day from 1st to 8th november. the conditions mentioned above also apply for this. mass for the bereaved friday 13th november 7:30pm november is the month of remembering our deceased loved ones, but it is also an important time to reach out to those who grieve their loss. recent grief can be very hard to navigate, but many also carry a silent grief from years past. mass for people in the parish who have been bereaved & for all those who feel the pain of loss, heavy within them, will take place in athenry church friday 13th november at 7:30pm. this is a mass for both athenry & newcastle church areas. please inform anyone that may like to attend. “cuppa” after mass in pastoral centre diocesan funeral ministry the funeral ministry training programme will take place in 2027. if anyone else is interested in funeral ministry but hasn’t yet registered, you are still very welcome to join. it’s not too late!
